entries.basis: The epoch captures the exact working source bytes, Git HEAD, dirty status, and binary patch.
The selected toolchain is authenticated by tehm-orfs-toolchain-manifest-v1 and a clean ORFS checkout.
The selected M0 is a content-addressed bundle verified by the current bundle verifier; its effect claims remain limited to its own fixtures.

Independent raw-evidence audit reports 6/6 external-design frontend/synthesis onboarding cases PASS with the full frozen denominator, six EDA calls, zero model calls, and unchanged source. This is not functional repair, fixed-flow, source-lineage, or memory-effect evidence.

The derivative inventory binds gcd and uart to explicit top/filelist, a clean official ORFS Git HEAD, and frozen config/SDC support bytes; it records no logic changes or generated stubs and grants no flow authority.
Independent raw-evidence audit reports 2/2 explicitly adapted official-control frontend/synthesis cases PASS with two EDA calls, zero model calls, and unchanged source.

A source-bound staged gcd control ran the serial fixed flow once: synth, floorplan, place, and CTS passed; route terminated with GRT-0232 routing congestion; finish was not executed. Independent audit f3db14f9 classifies this as a scoped FLOW_TARGET_FAILURE with five EDA stages, zero model calls, unchanged source, and no memory update. The producer epoch association is caller-supplied and toolchain-consistent because run-meta does not embed the epoch digest. This is negative S0 onboarding evidence, not repair or memory-effect evidence.

Adapter schema v2 keeps source authority on corrected read-only inventory 7c7b6e84 and support authority on clean ORFS HEAD 0c162cf5. The derivative inventory digest is 10741bbb; RTL is unchanged, the single-clock SDC retarget is explicit, and declared verilog-axis lineage remains unverified metadata.

Independent raw-evidence audit 8517f716 reports 1/1 PASS for the corrected adapter-bound external design with one EDA call, zero model calls, 1.669181 seconds, and unchanged source. This establishes scoped frontend onboarding only.

The corrected source-bound ll_axis_bridge project ran the serial fixed flow once: synth passed and floorplan terminated with PDN-0185 insufficient strap width; later stages were not executed. Independent audit 59030690 classifies this as FAIL / pdn_geometry_infeasible / FLOW_TARGET_FAILURE with two EDA stages, 13 seconds, zero model calls, unchanged RTL, and no memory update. No geometry adjustment or retry was applied.

Projection 802b2dbf summarizes the canonical one-official plus one-external denominator as 0 PASS, 2 FAIL, 0 UNKNOWN, with seven executed EDA stages, 69 seconds, and zero model calls. It explicitly leaves replay, expansion, S1, and S2 pending and grants no production authority.
The earlier 2/2 official preflight established tool compatibility but used inferred top/filelist. It is superseded for onboarding by the explicit adapter-bound replay.
Three immutable failed attempts expose runtime wiring defects in option quoting, top-name quoting, and process lowering. They were not overwritten or counted as design failures after correction.

The first audit invocation failed closed before output because the auditor assumed a ten-character ORFS short SHA while the runner emitted nine. Commit 94e09a2 replaced substring matching with exact root plus validated SHA-prefix parsing; the fixed flow was not rerun or overwritten.

An earlier external adapter attempt bound the rc1 inventory rather than the campaign-bound rc2 inventory. Its source bundle independently reached the same PDN-0185 failure, but its manifest and exclusion-chain digest differ; the immutable attempt is not mixed into the canonical denominator and was superseded by a new v2 adapter, epoch, workspace, attempt, and audit.
Revision3 used an older review baseline and cannot identify the current checkout.
README narratives guide replay but are not substituted for their external raw artifacts or a current independent audit.

S0 remains incomplete: both initial fixed-flow cases have terminal FLOW_TARGET_FAILURE results, isolated replay is pending, the second official control has not run fixed flow, and expansion has not closed. All S1/S2 real-design comparisons remain pending; no repair, memory-effect, agent-capability, source-independence, or production result is established.
